name: slopify
description: Outcome-driven engineering and research through explicitly invoked workflows: shape turns an idea into a story with observable acceptance criteria; deliver-story, deliver-bugfix, and deliver-spike take a story, a bug, or a question to a verified PR or a findings document; reproduce-bug reproduces a report and files it; review-pr runs the PR review loop; research investigates new sources and persists cited evidence in the project library. Skills: ask answers from the library, lint checks and repairs it, bootstrap sets up the board and forge declarations and the library. Agents: single-task scouts (gather), lenses (validate), and advisors (judge); coder and writer (produce); qa (validates code); pusher (the only board and forge operator); watcher (waits for reviews); auditor (validates setup); and the library agents.
